title: Binary Cyclic Decoder
text: 解码 BCH 码以恢复二进制向量数据，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；按 {Primitive polynomial} 指定本原多项式 ’X^4 + X +；{Codeword length, N} 指定码字长度、{Message length, K} 指定消息长度、{Shortened message length, S} 指定缩短的消息长度、{Generator polynomial} 指定生成多项式、{Disable generator polynomial checking} 用于禁用生成多项式检查、{Puncture vector} 指定删余向量、{Enable erasures input port} 用于启用删除输入端口、{Output number of corrected errors} 用于启用输出已纠正错误数端口，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 编码消息 binary column vector

ports.name: Era
ports.summary: 擦除向量 binary column vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 解码消息 binary column vector

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: 生成多项式 ’X^10 + X^8 + X^5 + X^4 + X^2 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | binary Galois row vector

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: 本原多项式 ’X^4 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector

params.name: Disable generator polynomial checking
params.values: 用于禁用生成多项式检查的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Puncture vector
params.values: 删余向量 [ones(8,1); zeros(2,1)] (default) | column vector

params.name: Enable erasures input port
params.values: 用于启用删除输入端口的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Output number of corrected errors
params.values: 用于启用输出已纠正错误数端口的选项 off (default) | on
